# FY2025 Budget Memo

The fiscal year 2025 budget was approved by the Chief Financial Officer, Maria Gonzalez, on January 15, 2025.

## Allocations
The marketing budget is set at $1.2 million, a modest increase over the previous year. Research and development spending grows by 18 percent to support the new product line. Capital expenditure for the warehouse expansion is planned at $3.4 million.

## Cost Controls
Travel spending is capped at $150,000 for the entire year and every trip above $2,000 needs director approval. Department heads must report variances above 5 percent to finance every quarter.
